target_customer: Music marketers and A&R staff at record labels, plus brands and creators running short form video campaigns on TikTok
problem: Marketers could not tell which sounds and formats would go viral on TikTok, so campaigns were guesswork.
business_model: B2B SaaS analytics subscription, with a self serve plan launched in October 2022
product_category: Short form video analytics and trend insights

founders.name: Yoav Zimmerman
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

founders.name: Jonathan (Yoni) Ben-tzur
previous_startups: Founded and scaled his own company (unnamed)
founders.background_notes: YC page says 15+ years of experience across data engineering, product and team development.

technical_complexity.rationale: Collecting and analysing over a billion social video posts and modelling recommendation behaviour needed solid data engineering and scraping at scale.

defensibility.rationale: A large archive of video data helped, but TikTok access and rival analytics tools limited the lead.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; Collab bought it in February 2022 and Trendpop stayed a subsidiary with the founders in their roles.

market_need_then: Record labels were running large TikTok marketing programs in 2020 to 2021; YC and the company state it grew to profitability within 12 months (company statement, not independently verified).

branding.domain_note: Held trendpop.com, which now redirects (301) to the acquirer's site collab.inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission led, about helping anyone go viral on social video.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by trade outlets such as HITS Daily Double and Tubefilter, but no evidence of community or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Known to music marketing trade press and used by major labels (company claim), but little brand coverage beyond product and deal news.

outcome_analysis: Trendpop was started in August 2020, joined YC in Winter 2021, claimed profitability after about a year using about 500K of aggregator reported funding, and was acquired by the creator platform Collab in February 2022 with the founders staying on. The TikTok boom and its record label customers made it a cheap, fast growing asset, so the exit was early and capital efficient.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights shows about 500K over 2 rounds (a convertible note dated 1 January 2021 and the acquisition); not recorded as rounds. Acquisition date: YC page says January 2022 while Tubefilter, Mergr and PrivSource date the announcement to 15 February 2022; February used. Profitability and label customers come from the company's own YC description. No dated 2021 competitor source found (only 2025 to 2026 roundups mention Tokboard, Pentos, Exolyt), so the list is empty. Collab acquisition price undisclosed.
